 Winter-like temperatures are upon us 
 Frigid weather for today 
 By Reagan Hurt Published : Nov. 13, 2026 at 6:42 AM CST | Updated : 48 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BOWLING GREEN, Ky. (WBKO) - For your Friday, you can expect cold conditions with cloudy skies, moderate wind gusts, and temperatures in the 30s-40s throughout the day. 
 We could also see a brief drizzle this afternoon, mostly for areas east of I-65, although most places will stay dry. As we head toward the overnight hours, mostly cloudy skies begin to clear up for sunny skies this weekend, but only after seeing 20-degree temperatures Saturday morning.
 Clearing skies lead to more efficient cooling of temperatures. (Reagan Hurt) We’ll gradually see afternoon temperatures warming up over the next few days. Starting with mid-50s Sunday and Monday, then near 60 degrees towards the middle of next week. However, overnight temperatures and morning lows will stay at or below freezing. 
 Gradually warming up over the next few days (Reagan Hurt) Conditions are expected to stay calm for the weekend and next week, with dry air and helping to warm us up slightly towards next week. Long-range models indicate calm weather through next weekend.
